t: 10ltr dry vacuum cleaner with 800W Eco motor, built for power and long-lasting performance with quiet operation. Features 2m anti-crush hose with airflow-controlled handle, 3-stage filtration system with advanced HEPA 13 pre-filter and pre-motor foam filter ensuring long-life cleaning. Includes high-performance dual-mode floor nozzle suitable for both carpet and hard floors, with easy switching between modes to achieve the best suction results on all surfaces.
